description: Searches individual bookings. Each row has period, cost_center, account, sub_account, contra_account, contra_sub_account (null if none), amount, description, transaction_date (day-exact booking date), `id` (the transaction_id for propose-transaction-correction) and `source` ("upload" or "manual"), plus correction_status ("none" | "pending" | "corrected") and correction_role (null | "reversal" | "rebooking"): whether a booking has an open or approved correction, or is itself the reversal/re-booking line of one. accounts takes "8400" (main account) or "8400/130"; each entry matches exactly that variant and unknown accounts are rejected. text_query is a case-insensitive substring of description OR reference; % and _ are searched as characters, not as wildcards. limit_count is a whole number of at least 1 (default 200, values above 1000 are capped at 1000; anything else is rejected). With truncated=true more bookings match than were returned; beyond 1000 only narrowing the filters helps. available_range gives the tenant's data range. With group_by the response carries `groups` (by period and/or cost center, each with transaction_count and transactions_truncated) instead of `rows`. Counts are reported in total_count (returned bookings), group_count (groups) and transaction_count per group; limit_count is a cap, not a count. The tool returns single bookings; sums per month, cost center or account come from compute_aggregates.

accounts.description: Accounts as "8400" (main account, same as "8400/000") or "8400/130" (sub-account). Each entry matches exactly that variant ("8400" excludes "8400/130"); unknown accounts are rejected. This is the account_ref notation of get_all_accounts and of the compute_aggregates groups.

cost_centers.description: Cost center numbers; get_cost_center_list maps names to numbers.

date_from.description: Day-exact lower bound on transaction_date, inclusive (YYYY-MM-DD). Omit for no lower bound.

date_to.description: Day-exact upper bound on transaction_date, inclusive (YYYY-MM-DD). Omit for no upper bound.

group_by.description: Optional. Groups the bookings by these fields; the response then carries `groups` instead of `rows`.

limit_count.description: Max rows: a whole number >= 1 (default: 200; values above 1000 are capped at 1000)

organization_id.description: ID of the organization this call runs in (from list_organizations). Required for tools that change data when you belong to more than one organization. Read tools use the active organization when omitted. Does not change the active organization.

periods.description: Months as YYYY-MM. Omit for every available period.

text_query.description: Literal case-insensitive substring of description OR reference; %, _ and \ are characters, not wildcards.

name: search_cost_center_transactions
